title: Generalized outer-electron radii of neutral Coulomb atoms
main_claim: For every choice of neutral two-spin Coulomb ground states Psi_Z, the outer radius R_m (radius beyond which the expected electron mass is m) satisfies m^{1/3} limsup_Z R_m -> (81 pi^2/2)^{1/3} and m^{1/3} liminf_Z R_m -> (81 pi^2/2)^{1/3} as m -> infinity.
coverage:
I read all six sections and the appendix line by line. Using sympy I checked the TF constants: k=2^{3/2}/(3pi^2), A*=(12/(4pi k))^2=81pi^2/8, Delta|x|^{-4}=12|x|^{-6}, exterior mass 4A*/r^3=b_TF^3/r^3, and the e_l mass bound 32pi/3 q^{-5}.

Section 3. The inversion of the comparison implications into |sigma-k F_+^{3/2}|<=q^{-8}|x|^{-6} works in all three cases (t>=h_h is excluded by the cap with xi<1; middle case; low case). Also checked: the band 4L_1 r_j>=2q s with L_1=q^2, the diagonal stage choice, and the probability of G_l via Markov on E int p_j.

Section 4. Spherical-mean nonnegativity follows from exact neutrality via Newton's identity. The L1 bound 8pi C_cap d^{-4}, then harmonic interior estimates, give compactness. The dilation-invariant absolute bound holds. The barrier transfer works: the subtraction cancels the nucleus and the inner density; (W)_+ is in H^1_0 by a regularity check at the origin; monotonicity of f gives the sign; L_l(x)->0; then let S->infinity. The rigidity argument is correct: weak contact at an approximate sup and inf gives b<=A*<=h.

Section 5. The packet support sandwich holds (t_z<=c_1 s^w|z|, and clamped packets are o(s)). L2 uniform integrability gives s^3||N||_2<=C(1+sqrt(D_0) s^{7/2}). Dyadic tightness CM^{-3} holds with constants independent of u and M. The finite-threshold argument (Z_min>=m^{4/3}, so the sequence is admissible) gives both iterated limits uniformly over ground states.

Companion inputs. I checked the cited results in the companion source against how they are used here: Prop 10.1 (comparison), Prop 11.2 (intermediate subsolutions, error bound C(r_0^{32}+r_j^{19/2-3w})), Cor 4.9 (annular counts), Lemma 12.2 with t=4, and Prop 12.3 (offset). They match, including the shared packets with the upper clamp only on the w-power factor. I did not re-verify the companion proofs themselves; sibling rank34 reported no gap in them.

One harmless nit: in the middle case of the inversion, the constant (3/2)k sqrt(h_h) xi should be (3/2)k sqrt(h_h+xi) xi. It is absorbed by choosing xi small.
